issues.on_page: Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (pp4-5) Total Governmental Funds column: Cash and cash equivalents 1,297,354; Certificates of deposit 114,975; County treasurer cash 11,360; Total assets 1,423,689; fund balances Restricted 432,047 / 65,822 / 775,850, Assigned 34,746 / 22,757 / 1,492 / 98,960, Unassigned (7,985)
issues.issue: Balance-sheet basis rule (user 2026-10-27): cash-basis reports take governmental lines from the governmental funds statement where its totals equal the government-wide figures. Here they are equal (1,423,689 both) and the government-wide governmental column has no capital assets, debt or interfund amounts, so the governmental lines (and equity by classification) should probably come from pp4-5. All amounts recorded match p1 as printed.

issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 146,918 (SoA p2-3: operating grants 91,845, capital grants 55,073)
issues.issue: Source of the grants and contributions is not stated; the Fire department's 84,212 (p17) is matched by a 142,117 'Donation expense', so part may be private contributions. Kept as one line per the mixed-label ruling; category is a judgment call (same for detail[5], detail[8], detail[15], detail[87]).

issues.on_page: Utilities and telephone 39,320 (proprietary funds, cost-type line)
issues.issue: Under the utility cost-type rule (user 2026-10-28) this cost-type line's category is the generic function name 'utilities', which can't be told apart from the function lines; a cost-type name such as 'Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone)' may be intended.

issues.on_page: Medical Building Fund - Charges for services 18,500
issues.issue: Medical Building Fund charges are likely rent from the city-owned medical building (Rentals), but the page does not say so; left as charges for services.
